on_reject: Keep the current configuration and record the reasons.

rules.name: validity
rules.statement: No run ends HARNESS after one rerun, judged from run metadata.

rules.name: no regression
rules.statement: Every check that passes on a control case under the current configuration also passes under the candidate.

rules.name: improvement
rules.statement: The candidate passes strictly more development-case checks; with repeated runs, its worst run must beat the current configuration's best.

rules.name: held-out
rules.statement: The candidate passes at least as many held-out checks.

rules.name: time
rules.statement: The candidate's total wall-clock time is at most 1.5 times the current configuration's.
